findings.claim: The Deploy to Cloudflare template needs the deployer to replace a visible placeholder before the application becomes usable.
findings.repro: Deploy the root Wrangler config without changing DEMO_AUTH. The Worker returns 503 by design. The deploy form binding description and README tell the deployer to replace it.

findings.claim: Every caller with the shared Basic credential reaches the same Durable Object instance and can reset or change the shared demo state.
findings.repro: Authenticate from two browser sessions and call /api/reset from either session. README.md lists the single shared instance as a known gap.

findings.claim: The deploy target is proven through a public-repository check, Cloudflare redirect, clean clone, build, and Wrangler dry run. A second-account dashboard deployment was not performed.
findings.repro: Open the button while logged out and observe the Cloudflare dashboard redirect. Inspect proof/deploy-button.json for the bounded evidence.
